summary: Enhance your knowledge of ISO 14067:2018 with our comprehensive course on measuring the carbon footprint of products. Enroll now to make a sustainable impact.
lede: ISO 14067 training covers methods for assessing a product’s greenhouse gas emissions across its life cycle. For sustainability, life-cycle assessment, product development and supply-chain professionals, it builds practical skills in setting functional units and system boundaries, compiling life-cycle inventory data, applying global warming potential and allocation methods, and analyzing and reporting results.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for product-level environmental performance, supply chain transparency, and sustainability reporting.
modules: Digital Tools and AI in LCA
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of greenhouse gas concepts and corporate sustainability. Familiarity with ISO 14001 or general Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) principles is beneficial but not required. A laptop with spreadsheet software is necessary for quantification exercises.
